ITEM 1 | Single mound-shaped piece, dark brown to reddish-brown with mottled variation, coarse crumbly grainy surface with small pale flecks scattered through it, matte with little sheen, dense and holding its shape, roughly 5 cm by 4 cm footprint and about 2.5 cm tall, sitting in the center of a pale blue square plate with no sauce pooled around it | 85 g
ITEM 2 | Small scattered pale tan-yellow crumb-like bits, roughly 0.3 to 0.5 cm each, dry and granular with slightly irregular edges, lying loose on the plate around the mound, about 10 pieces total | 4 g
